Brod na Kupi Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Rijeka, Croatia

Not demolished. Brod na Kupi's small Jewish community numbered 45 people in 1921, declining to 37 by 1931; a synagogue that once stood in the town was later demolished to build a new school. This cemetery, established in 1870 and abandoned after WWII, holds only a few surviving tombstones, including the monument of Solomon Roth, who died in 1896 and was rediscovered only a few years ago. In 2019, in coordination with the Israeli Embassy in Croatia, plans were made to commemorate the sites of the town's former Jewish community.
